The head is elongated with a pointed snout, and the mouth appears to be on the ventral surface. The tail is partially visible and appears heterocercal. The fish's coloration is dark gray/brown dorsally with a lighter ventral surface. The water is murky green-brown, and part of a white boat is visible in the foreground.
